examples.description: Get the client's view link and the document for an invoice
Replace the link with a new one (the old link stops working)

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name a invoice in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Send the error's next_call exactly as given: it is action 'rotate' for a new link, or a fresh 'revoke'.
failure_modes.when: action 'get' found the link revoked (SIMPLER_SALES_SHARE_LINK_REVOKED), or a repeated revoke found a newer live link (SIMPLER_SALES_SHARE_LINK_LIVE)

failure_modes.recovery: Send id, and omit action for get or use one of the three.
failure_modes.when: id is missing, or action is not get, rotate or revoke

failure_modes.recovery: The call waits for the owner's approval in the Simpler app; tell the owner and do not retry it. Nothing changes until the owner approves.
failure_modes.when: an agent's 'rotate' would re-issue a link the owner turned off (SIMPLER_SALES_SHARE_LINK_REISSUE_NEEDS_OWNER)

failure_modes.recovery: Retry shortly. No link is handed out, and a rotate changes nothing, while the document cannot be shown.
failure_modes.when: protected client details could not be resolved, so the document would render partially

preconditions: ONE call returns both the link and the document: no invoice_read or invoice_item_list is needed to show it.
Nothing is sent and the status does not change. Mark it sent with invoice_update once it has gone out.
An identical call within 24 hours counts as a retry. When an error's next_call carries fresh_after, send it as given: that makes it a new call.

share_url is built only on this environment's public address, never on the caller's. Where none is set, share_url is absent and share_path plus share_url_unavailable (the reason and the owner's fix) come back instead.

link_serving is false, with link_off_reason, once the invoice is cancelled or was paid more than 90 days ago: the payer then sees the same not-found page as for a turned-off link, and the page serves again only if the payment is reversed.

description: Returns share_url, the client's view link for this invoice, and the full document (parties, lines, totals in integer CENTS) in one call. action: 'get' (default) returns the live link; 'rotate' replaces it and the old link stops working; 'revoke' turns it off. A link the owner turned off stays off for agents: 'get' never re-issues it, and an agent's 'rotate' waits for the owner's approval. Anyone with the link can open the page until the invoice is cancelled or 90 days after payment (see link_serving). There is no PDF file yet; the link opens a print-ready page the client can print or save as PDF. Nothing is sent: give the link to the owner, who decides whether it goes to the client.

action.description: get (default): the live link, made the first time. rotate: replace it with a new link; the old one stops working. revoke: turn the link off.

fresh_after.description: Omit it. Only when an error's next_call includes fresh_after, send that call exactly as given.
